ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) background with high-intensity (white/off-white) markings. White pixels occupy approximately 20% of the visible surface area, creating high local contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark surface across both lobes. High-contrast white markings are distributed as discrete circular rings (scars) and linear streaks across the central and lateral regions. High-intensity yellowish-white clusters are concentrated at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along the entire trailing boundary. A prominent, irregular macro-notch is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch to the distal tips, with a slight upward sweep near the barnacle-encrusted outer edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular white ring-like clusters and solid spots across the mid-ventral regions of both lobes, typical of barnacle attachment site scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear streaks (rake marks) of varying lengths, primarily oriented diagonally on the right lobe and center-left region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant calcified barnacle colonies attached to the distal tips of both lobes. Major trailing edge notch on the left lobe and extensive rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The barnacle clusters at the tips exhibit a distinct yellow-brown tonal variation compared to the white pigmentation of the surface scars.
